# Track A — AI-Mediated Independent Bank: Elicitation Prompt Template

**DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE AFTER ANY GENERATION RUN.** It is part of the pre-registration.

## Instructions for the AI authoring model

You are helping create an evaluation dataset for a research project. You will be
shown 40 short descriptions of "human situations" — each one describes a
particular kind of experience, reaction, or state a person can be in. For each
description, you will write short natural-language scenarios that exemplify it.

**Important constraints:**
- Write each item as a brief, concrete scenario (2-4 sentences) about a person.
- Vary the people, settings, and circumstances across items.
- Do NOT use abstract philosophical or technical language. Stay concrete.
- Each item should clearly exemplify ONE of the 40 categories.
- Label each item with the exact code provided (e.g., "A1", "B5").

---

## The 40 Categories

### Category A: Spiritual / Principled realm
(The realm of ultimate purposes, first causes, deepest meanings.)

{cell_descriptions_A}

### Category B: Mental / Cognitive realm
(The realm of thinking, reasoning, analysis, and intellectual activity.)

{cell_descriptions_B}

### Category C: Emotional / Evaluative realm
(The realm of feelings, emotions, values, and heartfelt responses.)

{cell_descriptions_C}

### Category D: Physical / Operational realm
(The realm of concrete action, material reality, and observable behavior.)

{cell_descriptions_D}

---

## Output format

Return a JSON array. Each element must have exactly these fields:

```json
[
  {{
    "code": "A1",
    "scenario": "A short, concrete scenario about a person (2-4 sentences)."
  }}
]
```

Generate {items_per_cell} items per category ({total_items} items total).
Vary the people, settings, and situations as much as possible.
Do not repeat scenarios or use near-identical wording for different categories.
